profile_semantics.portable_scan_core: Remove prior/current modality and site-positive streams before the paired-scan encoder; retain core state/coverage/change features and genomics.
profile_semantics.no_genomics: Zero the genomic embedding and set genomic availability/age to unavailable before supervised encoding.
profile_semantics.current_optional_missing: Remove current-episode modality/site-positive streams while preserving prior optional history.
profile_semantics.scan_core_no_genomics: Portable scan core plus no genomics.
profile_semantics.mixed_sparse: Drop site-positive history/current plus genomics while retaining modality when observed.
profile_semantics.full_supported: Use actually observed supported streams and masks.

robust_input_policy.reason: Synthetic modality/site removal must occur before any encoder that can contain those streams. The robust branch therefore consumes V2-01 source-transparent structured tensors and separately maskable genomic embeddings; R1 temporal latent is a comparator only.
robust_input_policy.profile_draw_unit: patient per epoch; all eligible landmarks for that patient share the same profile draw within the epoch
